subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack channel discovery land as a focused `channel-info`/`channel-list` change, be handled through the open fork PR, or remain deferred?
rationale: The feature is source-reproducible and aligned with the Slack plugin boundary, but the same-repository attempts are closed unmerged and the remaining fork PR is partial/conflicting, so automation should not create a duplicate implementation without maintainer direction.

options.title: Split focused discovery work
options.body: Land a narrow Slack plugin PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, leaving search and broader Slack parity work for separate review.

options.title: Continue from the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author to rebase, add `channel-info`, and provide real Slack proof before using it as the canonical fix path.

options.title: Defer Slack discovery
options.body: Keep this accepted feature request open until maintainers are ready to expand the Slack action surface.

recommendation.title: Split focused discovery work
recommendation.body: Land a narrow Slack plugin PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, leaving search and broader Slack parity work for separate review.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent Slack action/runtime history and authored the broad Slack action-parity branch that overlapped this request.
